Trigger You are about to attempt a Recall Knowledge check

Requirements Declared Signal

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. Do not roll the check; treat the d20 as a 15 and apply all your modifiers to it normally. This must be declared before the check is attempted, and it must be declared Signal, so a failure costs you 2 force damage per level and 1 Signal Drift as always.
